name: File Browser
short_description: Self-hosted web file manager with a clean, modern interface.
description: File Browser provides a web-based file management interface for your server. Browse, upload, delete, preview, rename and edit files. Supports user management, sharing, and authentication. A lightweight alternative to cloud storage services.
usecases: Browse and manage files on your server through any web browser.
Upload and download files securely without exposing SSH access.
Share files with others via direct links.
